hypothesis: A global catalog of independently sampled valid scope-111 Golomb rulers, combined with rare-difference exact-cover branching, can assemble seven mutually disjoint rows even though baseline-anchored local repair and irreversible greedy assembly failed.
rationale: The previous methods either remained near the scope-112 witness or sampled candidates only around fixed rows. The frozen DTS contract is exactly a seven-row packing of 15-difference Golomb rulers into differences 1..111 with six unused values. A global catalog removes the baseline neighborhood assumption while exact branching preserves compatibility and explicitly accounts for the six gaps.
expected_information_gain: Tests a new global construction family and identifies whether the main obstacle is the published witness basin or the scarcity/compatibility of scope-111 Golomb rulers themselves.
method: Generate up to 250,000 deduplicated valid scope<=111 Golomb-ruler masks by uniform random sampling of five marks from 1..111, with seed 20260827 and 1,500,000 attempts. Build an inverted difference index and recursively branch on the uncovered difference with the fewest currently compatible catalog rows, allowing at most six explicit gaps, until seven disjoint rows are selected. Use a 120-second wall budget and 2,000,000-node cap, then independently validate any complete assignment with verify_dts.verify.
metric: catalog cardinality, exact-cover nodes, maximum assembled depth, target assignment, and independent DTS validity
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A complete seven-row assignment accepted by the independent integer validator is exactly a true-objective scope<=111 witness; a catalog or search failure is only evidence about the sampled finite family and not global infeasibility.

configuration.cover_branching: rarest uncovered difference plus six-gap budget

kill_condition: Stop at a validator-valid assignment, catalog/DFS completion, or 120 seconds/2,000,000 nodes; do not infer global infeasibility from a finite random catalog.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if complete and validator-valid

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: new global candidate family and exact compatibility evidence

interpretation: A 250,000-row uniform scope-111 Golomb catalog was generated, but exact rare-difference branching reached only depth 4 before the 2,000,000-node cap. This matches the earlier global-greedy ceiling and yields no target candidate; it is finite sampled-family evidence only.
what_was_learned: Removing the baseline-neighborhood assumption did not improve assembled depth under a large uniform catalog. The obstacle is likely structured compatibility scarcity rather than only local repair; more uniform sampling or a larger node budget is low-value without a structural bias.
recommended_next_action: If a witness is found, freeze and independently/adversarially verify it; otherwise close this uniform-catalog family and require a structured/algebraic construction or stronger catalog bias.
repetition_justification: This is a new global construction family: it does not perturb or sample around the published rows and uses explicit exact-cover gap branching instead of irreversible greedy selection.
